items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Secures Long Term Power Deals And Expands Optimus Teleoperation

The company has also agreed a long term power purchase arrangement in Texas with Zelestra for the Lumen Farm solar project. Tesla’s Optimus humanoid robot unit has acquired Virtuix’s Omni One Enterprise system, expanding its capabilities in robotics teleoperation.
